# Deskera

> Deskera is a comprehensive cloud-based ERP platform providing integrated accounting, inventory management, manufacturing, CRM, and tax compliance solutions for small and medium-sized businesses.

Deskera offers industry-specific ERP modules including Deskera Books (accounting), Deskera MRP (manufacturing), and warehouse management systems with built-in GST compliance, e-invoicing, and statutory reporting for markets including India, Singapore, and Malaysia.

## Key Topics

- Deskera ERP
- Deskera Books
- GST Compliance
- Inventory Management
- Manufacturing ERP
- Supply Chain Management
- Tax Filing & Compliance
- Warehouse Management
- Production Planning
- E-Invoicing
- Accounting Software
- User Permissions & Access Control
- Statutory Compliance
- MRP (Material Requirements Planning)
- Industry-Specific ERP Solutions

## Tax & Compliance

- [Tax filing made easier for small businesses with Deskera](https://www.deskera.com/books/tax): Deskera Books tax filing features with automated workflows for SMBs
- [Online Accounting Software to Generate an e-Invoice and IRN](https://www.deskera.com/books/e-invoicing): Deskera Books e-invoicing with GST compliance and IRN generation
- [Statutory Compliance Software - Deskera](https://www.deskera.com/erp/statutory-compliance): Deskera ERP statutory compliance for Singapore, Malaysia, India tax
- [GST impact on High Sea Sales](https://www.deskera.com/in/gst-impact-on-high-sea-sales): GST impact analysis on high sea sales and interstate trade in India
- [GST is an inspiration for 'Make in India'](https://www.deskera.com/in/gst-is-an-inspiration-for-make-in-india): How GST supports Make in India initiative for manufacturing growth

## Core ERP Features

- [Cloud ERP System - Top Product Management Features for SMEs](https://www.deskera.com/erp/product-management): Deskera ERP product management features for inventory & pricing
- [Deskera ERP with Advanced Checklist Management Features](https://www.deskera.com/erp/checklist-management): Deskera ERP checklist management for EOD operations & cycle counts
- [Deskera Partner | Deskera](https://www.deskera.com/partner): Deskera Partner Program for MSPs selling to SMB/SME market

## Manufacturing & Production

- [ERP Software for Plastic and Rubber Industry, Deskera](https://www.deskera.com/erp-software-for-plastic-and-rubber-industry): Deskera ERP for plastic/rubber industry with molding & extrusion mgmt
- [ERP Software Solution for Cement Industry, Deskera](https://www.deskera.com/erp-software-for-cement-industry): Deskera ERP for cement industry with BI & production management
- [Grab the Recipe for Success with Our Food Manufacturing Software](https://www.deskera.com/industries/food-manufacturing-erp): Deskera MRP for food manufacturing with recipe & batch management
- [The Powerhouse Solution Your Footwear Manufacturing Business has been Searching For!](https://www.deskera.com/industries/footwear-manufacturing): Deskera ERP for footwear manufacturing with automation & tracking
